tools_added.description: Execute or wait for one bounded Luau cell. Arguments are a JSON object. cursor, yield_time_ms and max_output_tokens use JSON integers; exact nonnegative decimal strings (including integral decimal or exponent forms) are converted before the same range checks. Example exec arguments: {"action":"exec","script":"return 1 + 1","yield_time_ms":0,"max_output_tokens":1024}. exec creates a globally unique cell_id; wait reads incremental output after cursor without replay. yield_time_ms returns early without cancelling the managed VM. wait resumes yield_control unless continue_execution=false. When the returned page has vm_alive=true or has_more=true, callers must continue invoking action="wait" with the same cell_id and cursor=next_cursor until vm_alive=false and has_more=false; do not replay exec. Helpers inside the Luau script: store(key,value,expected_version), load(key), text(string), image(mime,base64), audio(mime,base64), notify(message,completed,total), exit(code), yield_control(), toolDefinition(name), tool_search(query,limit). store(key,value,expected_version) requires all 3 arguments: expected_version is mandatory; pass 0 for a new key, or the version returned by load(key).version when updating an existing key. load(key) returns an object with version and value, or null if absent. ALL_TOOLS is a read-only array of tool names. toolDefinition and tool_search are Luau functions, not external tool names. Use return or cayw.emit(value) for JSON values, including tables. pcall/xpcall handle ordinary known errors; cancellation, exhausted budgets, unknown effects and exit still stop the cell. Pure computation coroutines and per-cell globals are available. Await host tools from the main script. print, io, os, package, require and math.tointeger are unavailable. Use ordinary Luau operators and bounded string/table/math/utf8 functions. Invoke host tools with cayw.call(name,args); each invocation is authorized. Do not register any other execute_code tool. max_output_tokens is a conservative serialized UTF-8 BYTE budget (minimum 1024), not provider token usage. A page too small for the next item returns required_budget with unchanged cursor. Restart recovers durable records, never a Lua stack. No automatic replay.
tools_added.name: execute_code
